scope: Single 960x720 Chromium page, default realtime shadows retained, no quality downgrade; default-entry camera and actual beacon overlays.
visualAcceptance: Screenshot capture completion is not visual acceptance; see browser-visual-review.json for actual image review.
captureSynchronization: Wait for panel slide transition to finish before computing default camera. Require loaded map/beacon sources and actual covered/residual source components. Compare source/clip/beacon fingerprints across two renders, then recheck before capture; a transient early pending=false is insufficient.
runtimeBindingMeaning: Each capture carries its actual runtime binding. Earlier four accepted geometry views retain their original loaded sources; Stele final uses the fixed-nameplate production reload.
